text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Finished changing.
My legs are feeling pretty good, too.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
All that's left is to take 1st place
in the Tulip Sho.
choice_data_list: You're fully fired up, aren't you.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, naturally. On this Tiara route,
everyone knows *I'm* the top favorite—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I heard someone shouting 'Number one! Number one!' so loud,
and when I come check, it really is you."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, though—the winner of this race is me.
Better luck next time, Honor Student.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...My, appearing out of nowhere like that,
whatever are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
The one getting utterly crushed this time is you.
And the one running home in utter disgrace will be you, too.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Haaah!? You picking a fight with me!?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"What?! You're the one who picked a fight
first, aren't you?!"
choice_data_list: Calm down, it's right before the race.
Calm down, the race is about to start.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I figured you'd go for the Tiara route
based on your best distance, but still!! I mean, really!!
choice_data_list: Go crush them in the race
Go beat them in the race

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Of course! I'm going to totally dominate this race!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm the one who's gonna win this race
and build up that momentum!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna show everyone
that *I'm* the number one!
